# Additions to Daniel Chapter 1 (Prayer of Azariah & Song of the Three) — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Codex Vaticanus (Theodotion recension), Additions to Daniel 1
**Source Image:** source-texts/greek-DC/ADD_001_page_001.jpg

---

## Council Decision

This chapter divides into three parts: (1) the narrative introduction to Azariah's prayer; (2) the Prayer of Azariah — a penitential psalm; (3) the narrative bridge (fire, angel); (4) the Song of the Three, the Benedicite — a liturgical cosmic hymn.

**For the Prayer of Azariah:** LOGOS provides the base; PNEUMA contributes emotional urgency especially at vv. 7–12 and 18–19. The penitential tone must be preserved without being flattened.

**For the Song of the Three (Benedicite):** PNEUMA's line-break formatting is adopted for the entire hymn. This is a LITURGICAL POEM and must be set as poetry. The refrain is standardized as: "sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever." The word "steadfast love" is used for ἔλεος at Song.40–41 (= Hebrew hesed), consistent with the project's established convention.

---

### The Prayer of Azariah

**Pr.Az.1** They walked in the midst of the fire, singing hymns to God and blessing the Lord.

**Pr.Az.2** And Azariah stood and prayed; opening his mouth in the midst of the fire, he said:

**Pr.Az.3** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers,
worthy of praise and exaltation above all, forever.

**Pr.Az.4** And blessed is your holy and glorious name,
worthy of highest praise and exaltation above all, forever.

**Pr.Az.5** You are righteous in all that you have done to us.
All your works are true, your ways are straight, and all your judgments are truth.

**Pr.Az.6** True judgments you have executed in all that you have brought upon us and upon Jerusalem, the holy city of our fathers — for in truth and in justice you brought all these things upon us because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.7** For we sinned and acted lawlessly in departing from you.

**Pr.Az.8** In everything we sinned and did not listen to your commandments;

**Pr.Az.9** we did not keep them and did not do as you commanded us, so that things might go well for us.

**Pr.Az.10** All that you brought upon us and all that you did to us, you did in just judgment.

**Pr.Az.11** You gave us into the hands of lawless enemies, hateful rebels, and an unjust king — the most evil in all the earth.

**Pr.Az.12** And now we cannot open our mouths; shame and reproach have come upon your servants and upon those who worship you.

**Pr.Az.13** Do not give us up forever, for the sake of your name;
do not annul your covenant.

**Pr.Az.14** Do not withdraw your mercy from us —
for the sake of Abraham your beloved,
and Isaac your servant,
and Israel your holy one —

**Pr.Az.15** to whom you promised to multiply their descendants as the stars of heaven and as the sand on the shore of the sea.

**Pr.Az.16** For, Lord, we have become fewer than all the nations, and are humbled this day throughout all the earth because of our sins.

**Pr.Az.17** At this time there is no prince or prophet or leader, no burnt offering or sacrifice or oblation or incense, no place to bring first-fruits before you and to find mercy.

**Pr.Az.18** But may we be accepted with a contrite soul and a humble spirit —

**Pr.Az.19** as with burnt offerings of rams and bulls, and tens of thousands of fat lambs, so let our sacrifice be before you this day, and may it be wholly pleasing before you; for there is no shame for those who trust in you.

**Pr.Az.20** Now we follow you with our whole heart; we fear you and seek your face.

**Pr.Az.21** Do not put us to shame, but deal with us according to your gentleness and the abundance of your mercy.

**Pr.Az.22** Deliver us according to your wonderful works and bring glory to your name, O Lord.

**Pr.Az.23** Let all who do evil to your servants be put to shame; let them be disgraced and stripped of all their power, and let their strength be broken.

**Pr.Az.24** Let them know that you alone are the Lord God, glorious over all the earth."

**Pr.Az.25** And the servants of the king who had thrown them in did not stop feeding the furnace with naphtha, pitch, tow, and brushwood,

**Pr.Az.26** and the flame shot out above the furnace forty-nine cubits,

**Pr.Az.27** and it spread and burned those Chaldeans whom it found around the furnace.

**Pr.Az.28** But the angel of the Lord descended into the furnace to be with Azariah and his companions, and he drove the fiery flame out of the furnace,

**Pr.Az.29** and made the inside of the furnace as though a moist, whistling breeze were blowing through; and the fire did not touch them at all, nor cause them pain, nor trouble them in any way.

---

### The Song of the Three Young Men (Benedicite omnia opera)

**Song.1** Then the three, as with one mouth, praised and glorified and blessed God in the furnace, saying:

**Song.2** "Blessed are you, O Lord, God of our fathers —
most highly praised and exalted above all, forever.

**Song.3** Blessed is your holy and glorious name —
most highly praised and exalted above all, forever.

**Song.4** Blessed are you in the temple of your holy glory —
most highly praised and exalted above all, forever.

**Song.5** Blessed are you upon the throne of your kingdom —
most highly praised and exalted above all, forever.

**Song.6** Blessed are you who look upon the depths
and sit enthroned above the cherubim —
praised and exalted above all, forever.

**Song.7** Blessed are you in the firmament of heaven —
most highly praised and glorified, forever.

---

**Song.8** Bless the Lord, all you works of the Lord —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.9** Bless the Lord, you angels of the Lord —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.10** Bless the Lord, you heavens —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.11** Bless the Lord, all you waters above the heavens —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.12** Bless the Lord, all you hosts of the Lord —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.13** Bless the Lord, sun and moon —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.14** Bless the Lord, stars of heaven —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.15** Bless the Lord, every shower and dew —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.16** Bless the Lord, all you winds —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.17** Bless the Lord, fire and heat —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.18** Bless the Lord, winter cold and summer heat —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.19** Bless the Lord, dews and hoarfrosts —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.20** Bless the Lord, frost and cold —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.21** Bless the Lord, ice and snow —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.22** Bless the Lord, nights and days —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.23** Bless the Lord, light and darkness —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.24** Bless the Lord, lightning and clouds —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.25** Let the earth bless the Lord —
let it sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.26** Bless the Lord, mountains and hills —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.27** Bless the Lord, everything that grows upon the earth —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.28** Bless the Lord, seas and rivers —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.29** Bless the Lord, all you springs —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.30** Bless the Lord, you whales and all things that move in the waters —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.31** Bless the Lord, all you birds of heaven —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.32** Bless the Lord, all you wild beasts and cattle —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.33** Bless the Lord, you sons of men —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.34** Bless the Lord, O Israel —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.35** Bless the Lord, you priests of the Lord —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.36** Bless the Lord, you servants of the Lord —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.37** Bless the Lord, spirits and souls of the righteous —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.38** Bless the Lord, you who are holy and humble of heart —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

**Song.39** Bless the Lord, Hananiah, Azariah, and Mishael —
sing his praise and exalt him above all, forever.

For he has rescued us from Hades
and saved us from the hand of death,
and delivered us from the midst of the burning fiery furnace —
from the very midst of the fire he has delivered us.

**Song.40** Give thanks to the Lord, for he is good —
for his steadfast love endures forever.

**Song.41** Bless all who fear the Lord, the God of gods —
sing his praise and give thanks to him,
for his steadfast love endures forever."
